Portless | AI Engineer (Founding seat) | Remote (North America) | $180k-$230k

AI usage today is basic — decks, spreadsheets, a few people vibe-coding dashboards. No real agentic workflows yet. This is a founding seat to build that: shipping high-impact agentic workflows yourself, plus reusable building blocks (APIs, MCP tools, docs) so any team can build their own.

Example first project: an agent for inbound invoice questions — reads the question, pulls the right invoice, drafts a context-aware reply — turning an hour of manual work into ~30 seconds.

Need: 3+ yrs SWE with 1-2+ yrs shipping production AI systems, 10+ real agentic/LLM workflows built end-to-end, a genuine platform mindset (built tools/infra for others, not just yourself), strong Python and/or TypeScript, and relevant sector background (e-commerce, 3PL, logistics, or similar B2B).

Nice to have: RAG pipelines, vector DBs, multi-step agent orchestration, eval frameworks.

Full JD + Apply: https://uctalent.io/referral/Huynh_Nhu_Bao_Nhan221138/DNwhgw...
